question: What will be the maximum intraday value of the VIX over these biweekly periods in Q4 2026? (Nov 23 - Dec 4)

calls.reasoning: VIX ~25.5 on Nov 18 after 4 straight gains (intraday 27.73 Nov 17; recent high 28.36 Nov 5) amid AI/tech selloff, chip restrictions, Nvidia CEO change, Anthropic IPO. Window Nov 23-Dec 4 is ~9 trading days (Thanksgiving closed, Nov 27 half day), starting 3 trading days out. Mean reversion after spikes and the seasonally calm Thanksgiving week pull the max-high down; the max-over-window effect, persistent tech stress and the Dec 4 jobs report push it up. Median of the max-high is near the current level. No Kalshi/Polymarket/Manifold contract found.

calls.reasoning: VIX was about 25.5 midday Nov 18. It hit intraday highs of 27.73 on Nov 17 and 28.36 on Nov 6, during an AI/chip selloff in which the S&P fell five days straight. Dec VX near 22.4 and short backwardation episodes (average 3.1 days) point to mean reversion to the low 20s by the time the window opens on Nov 23. Thanksgiving week is seasonally quiet. Against that, the max-of-window statistic adds upside skew, and live catalysts remain: Anthropic IPO trading, a likely Dec 4 jobs report, a Dec 9 hike priced near 93%, a 10y yield around 5.1%, and shutdown risk. I put the median max-high near current spot, with a fat right tail. No human market was found on Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi, per the runs; I did no searching myself.
calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the core facts: Nov 17 intraday high 27.73, close about 25.46, prior high 28.36 on Nov 6, Dec VX about 22.4, a 9-session window with Thanksgiving closed and a half day on Nov 27, and no human market. The small factual dispute over the Nov 17 close (25.46 vs 25.94) doesn't matter because the window starts later; most sources give 25.46. Run 3's Nov 13 contango data is from before the spike. The main disagreement is a judgment call on how much VIX decays before Nov 23 (Run 3 expects about 22) against persistent stress (Nov 18 midday 25.6 even after the Nvidia beat faded). Fresh negative catalysts keep coming, which argues against fast decay, while futures price about 22. I take a median near 24.8, close to Runs 1 and 2, because a 9-session max starting from a likely 21-24 open usually lands about 10% above the open. I had no web access and retrieved nothing.
